mapper.select: select (select count(1) from t_sale_order where status = 0 and is_deleted = 0) as draftOrders, (select count(1) from t_sale_order where status = 1 and is_deleted = 0) as confirmedOrders, (select count(1) from t_sale_order where status = 1 and is_deleted = 0 and delivery_date = #{tomorrow}) as pendingPurchase, (select count(1) from purchase_order where status = 0) as purchaseDraft, (select count(1) from purchase_order where status = 1) as purchasePendingCost, (select count(1) from t_delivery_order where status = 0 and is_deleted = 0) as pendingPrint, (select count(1) from t_delivery_order where status = 1 and is_deleted = 0) as pendingMarkDelivered, (select count(1) from t_delivery_order d where d.status = 2 and d.is_deleted = 0 and not exists (select 1 from acceptance a where a.delivery_order_id = d.id)) as pendingAcceptance, (select count(1) from order_adjustment) as pendingAdjust

select max(o.id) as deliveryId, max(o.code) as deliveryCode, o.customer_id as customerId, coalesce(c.alias, c.name) as customerName, o.customer_dept_id as deliveryPointId, cd.name as deliveryPointName, o.delivery_date as deliveryDate, (select pl.print_time from t_delivery_print_log pl where pl.customer_id = o.customer_id and pl.delivery_date = o.delivery_date and pl.customer_dept_id = o.customer_dept_id order by pl.print_time desc limit 1) as printTime from t_sale_order o left join t_customer c on c.id = o.customer_id left join t_customer_dept cd on cd.id = o.customer_dept_id where o.is_deleted = 0 and o.status = 1 and o.delivery_date <= curdate() and not exists (select 1 from acceptance a where a.customer_id = o.customer_id and a.customer_dept_id = o.customer_dept_id and a.delivery_date = o.delivery_date and a.status = 1) group by o.customer_id, o.customer_dept_id, o.delivery_date, coalesce(c.alias, c.name), cd.name order by o.delivery_date, o.customer_id
